_comment: Microsoft's built-in Conditional Access authentication strengths.
These three exist in every tenant with the same ids and the same names, so
they carry no tenant information and must not be masked. Their names also
appear verbatim inside CISA SCuBA control statements, and masking them there
rewrites the standard's own text and then trips the leak detector.
A tenant can create custom strengths. Those are tenant data, get a tenant
specific id, and are masked normally.
